Jess: Quick heads up — PR #8902 (kv-cache: reduce mem spike) is queued for the midnight cutover. We need 2x LGTM before 2026-03-18 23:45 PT or it misses the window.
Kai: On it. Any blocking CI?
ReleaseBot: CI | linux-compat: failed — tests/quant_integration_test.py::test_kv_stability (timeout)
Mira: That flaky test popped earlier. I can rerun the job now. If it flakes again we should consider cherry-pick without the test change and open follow-up.
Jess: Rerun please @ReleaseBot
ReleaseBot: CI rerun triggered by Mira — job 984321 — status: queued
Sam: I can give the second signoff once CI is green and I get a quick smoke on canary. How long to rollout?
Jess: Canary takes ~10 mins. We can do rolling canary to 10% then cut if stable.
Olivia: I'm on pager but can jump in after 22:30 PT. If not signed by cutoff, can we pin for next window? Need rollback plan.
Kai: Rollback plan is documented in the PR description (backout script + config toggles). If we hit cutoff without 2x LGTMs, we'll defer to next window and keep revert ready.
Mira: CI passed on rerun — linux-compat green. job 984321 ✅
Sam: Reviewing now. Quick note: a leftover debug log in handler — pushing tiny commit for removal.
Jess: Thanks — PR updated. Sam? second LGTM when ready.
Sam: LGTM. :thumbsup: 
Kai: LGTM from me as well. :tada:
Jess: Awesome — merge queued. Cutting canary in 5.
ReleaseBot: Deploy started: canary -> 10% -> expected completion 00:12 PT
Olivia: I'll monitor canary metrics for 30 mins. Ping if anything odd.
Jess: Closing thread — thanks everyone.
